hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0 ;; */tools/*|*/skills/*|*/knowledge/*|*/test/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/test/run_all.sh" ] || exit 0; cd "$r" || exit 0; L=/tmp/claude-ctf-gate.$$.log; if bash test/run_all.sh >"$L" 2>&1; then rm -f "$L"; exit 0; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"ctf-v2 gate FAILED after editing %s - see %s"}\n' "$f" "$L"; exit 2
